visual_action: The video starts with a static screenshot of a tweet from an account called 'FactPost'. The tweet shows a photo of Donald Trump next to a map of Texas and claims Texas Republicans are passing gerrymandered maps at Trump's request. It then cuts to a two-panel clip of Donald Trump outdoors, being asked a question and then answering it. The video concludes with a static, closer view of the gerrymandered map of Texas.

on_screen_text.text: Texas House Republicans have voted to pass their gerrymandered congressional maps.
The redrawn maps were requested by Trump amid fears about losing the House majority.
Are you calling for a complete redrawing of the congressional map?
No, a simple redrawing so we pick up five seats.

intended_effect: To generate outrage at Donald Trump and Republicans for allegedly manipulating the electoral system.
